research-loop.name: Research Loop
research-loop.description: Research -> Plan -> Implement -> Test -> Document -> Loop. The full CI/CD agent cycle, ending with docs once tests pass.

stages.name: Research
stages.prompt_template: Research improvements and opportunities for {topic}. Focus on actionable findings with clear implementation paths.

stages.name: Plan
stages.prompt_template: Based on the research findings, create implementation tasks. Branch if needed. Assign clear scope to each task.

stages.name: Implement
stages.prompt_template: Implement the planned changes. Follow the task description and acceptance criteria. Write tests alongside code.

stages.name: Test
stages.prompt_template: Run the test suite and verify the implementation. Report results clearly. When done, use the report_pipeline_result tool with status 'pass' or 'fail' and a summary.

stages.name: Document
stages.prompt_template: Document the just-shipped changes for {topic}. Inspect the relevant git commits, capture screenshots of new UI, record GIF workflows for new flows, and update the docs site. Use the documentor MCP tools (get_changes_since, screenshot_page, record_workflow, update_docs_manifest, build_docs), and include task IDs plus relevant commit_shas in update_docs_manifest.

tdd-loop.name: TDD Loop
tdd-loop.description: Implement -> Test -> Fix -> Repeat until green.

stages.name: Implement
stages.prompt_template: Implement the feature: {topic}. Write code with tests.

stages.name: Test
stages.prompt_template: Run all tests. When done, use the report_pipeline_result tool with status 'pass' or 'fail' and a summary of results.

review-loop.name: Review Loop
review-loop.description: Implement -> Code Review -> Revise -> Repeat until approved.

stages.name: Review
stages.prompt_template: Review the changes. Check code quality, correctness, and test coverage. Use the report_pipeline_result tool: 'pass' if approved or 'fail' with specific feedback.

verification-cascade.name: Verification Cascade
verification-cascade.description: Unit Tests -> E2E Tests -> Quality Audit, with fix-and-restart at every level. Escalating verification that checks if outputs are actually useful, not just working.

stages.name: Unit Tests
stages.prompt_template: Run unit tests for {topic}. Use pytest or the project's test framework. If relevant tests don't exist yet, write them first — cover core logic, edge cases, and gating conditions. When done, use the report_pipeline_result tool with status 'pass' if all tests pass, or 'fail' with the failure summary.

stages.name: E2E Tests
stages.prompt_template: Test {topic} end-to-end against the running system. Hit real API endpoints, start real sessions, verify WebSocket events arrive, check database state. Don't mock — test actual behavior. Verify the feature behaves as intended, not just that it doesn't crash. When done, use the report_pipeline_result tool with 'pass' or 'fail' and a behavioral summary.

stages.name: Quality Audit
stages.prompt_template: Audit the output quality of {topic}. This is NOT a correctness check — the previous stages already verified that. Your job: run the feature with realistic inputs and evaluate whether the outputs are actually USEFUL to a human user. Check: Are generated texts meaningful and relevant? Are suggestions actionable? Do edge cases produce reasonable results or garbage? Test with at least 3 different realistic scenarios. Compare outputs against what a good human-crafted version would look like. Report 'pass' via report_pipeline_result only if outputs are production-quality. Report 'fail' with specific examples of low-quality output and what 'good' would look like.

stages.name: Fix
stages.prompt_template: Fix the issues found during verification of {topic}. Address the root cause, not just symptoms. If the quality audit flagged misleading outputs, fix the data/context the feature uses, not just the formatting. If unit or e2e tests failed, fix the code and update tests if needed.

ralph-pipeline.name: RALPH Pipeline
ralph-pipeline.description: Execute -> Verify -> Fix -> Repeat. Multi-agent version of RALPH mode.

stages.name: Execute
stages.prompt_template: Execute the task: {topic}. Do the work completely.

stages.name: Verify
stages.prompt_template: Verify the work is correct. Run tests, check output, validate behavior. When done, use the report_pipeline_result tool with status 'pass' or 'fail' and a summary.

stages.name: Fix
stages.prompt_template: Fix the issues found during verification. Apply the feedback.

auto-dispatch.name: Auto-Dispatch
auto-dispatch.description: When a task enters Todo, automatically route it to Commander to spawn a worker and begin implementation. Enable the board_column trigger to make todo tasks self-dispatching. Commander checks current in_progress load before acting.

stages.name: Dispatch to Worker
